reasons: Every acceptance criterion maps to recipe or focused state-test evidence.
The inherited recipe reaches the exact Perps payment-method transition through manifest-declared UI actions.
The pre-fix baseline proves the evidence is sensitive to the defect.
Assertions are limited to measurements the runner can make reliably.
better_version_guidance: Use a native viewport assertion if the runner gains reliable React Native host-node measurement.

coverage.reason: Visual ACs use screenshots and presence assertions; timing-dependent state ACs use focused tests.

evidence_fit.reason: Visual behavior uses image evidence and non-visual behavior uses state-test evidence.

flake_risk.reason: The original defect is timing-sensitive, but the assertions target stable invariants rather than requiring the timing window.
